 Home News Local News SSA Announces 2027 COLA, Warns of Related Scams SSA Announces 2027 COLA, Warns of Related Scams
 Mon, November 2, 2026 by Reid Kamhi 
 SHARE NOW 
 Social Security benefit payments will increase 3.6% for the coming year. The Social Security Administration announced the cost-of-living adjustment on October 14. Speaking on the WTIM Morning Show, Public Affairs Specialist Jack Myers says beneficiaries will see the change as early as New Year’s Eve.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Myers-1-2026.10.30.mp3 
 Myers stresses that the increase is automatic, and beneficiaries do not need to take action to receive it.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Myers-2-2026.10.30.mp3 
 That scam is among many others the SSA is warning the public about. In a similar trend, scammers may call and promise increased benefits beyond the COLA changes in exchange for payment.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/Myers-3-2026.10.30.mp3 
 More information on the aforementioned scams is available at www.ssa.gov/scam .
